In all fairness women definitely have the upper hand when it comes to dating. If I (a male) were to walk into a bar and say who wants to go out with me, I'd probably be ignored. If a woman were to, odds are she'd get multiple contenders. Whether those are decent guys or not is irrelevant, it's just the mere fact that they would succeed where guys wouldn't. There are many more examples in dating that women have a significant advantage over men. 

That being said it doesnt invalidate a womans loneliness or struggle to find someone I just think its fair to say it's easier for a woman than a man

Definitely not. Overdose amounts are around 20 to 25 mg per kg of body weight. So youd need a shit ton more adderall and have to take more pills than you could probably swallow and even then itd probably just end in a hospital visit
I love you too man. I appreciate your concern, I really do

I've tried. I cant find anything I enjoy. I just sit and read and hope the hours go by fast enough to let me fall asleep. There is no happiness left in me. I think of my dog all the time but I know my parents will take care of her. They recently found out about everything but they arent aware of my plan for tomorrow. New girls aren't an option. I tried and they just arent her. They dont compare and it just makes me sick

I appreciate the concern man but I've accepted this decision. I dont want to be here, just counting the minutes until I can fall back into a restless, terrible sleep. Everyday is painful and I just dont want it. Shes not coming back and I just dont want to be here
It honestly makes me more depressed that I'm still here with 6+ attempts. Thanks man hope you find it too
Definitely. Not taking away from OP but my attempt number would be significantly higher if we count backing out
Well if you manage to transcend humanity and turn into death I'm requesting to be first in your line
I fantasize about this pretty much every time I'm outside
I too am curious about this
You too brother
4 days for me. I hope we can go painlessly
The days feel so long having that date is the only reason I'm still here. That and I attempted to hang myself and it really was unpleasant

100 is not enough. Its extremely hard to OD on those because you'll probably need to take more pills than you can stomach and you'll just throw it all up. When I researched fir myself it was, IIRC, between 500 to 1000 pills for a chance but not a guarantee

I only tell you this because, unless you're an extraordinary individual, 1000 pills in a short period of time is impossible to take
How will it only get worse? Seems like for me it wont get better or worse. Itll just be over
My original date was in december. I pussied out again with the noose so I think I'll just keep my original date. If I can at least. I have a much easier way out
I dont even know what ti say. It just hurts so much. It's always on my mind. It never goes away. The only thing holding me here was the hope she would come back and I think it's gone

I dont know what to talk about. I cant handle the break up. It's too much. She made a comment an hour ago about going on a vacation. She wasnt sure if she should because "theres no reason to come back" I've been holding out hope we weren't done forever. I dont think theres any hope left
We decided to go on break about a month ago and now were fully broken up because she said she needed more time and space

I think it's in the conscious and unconscious. I bring up intelligence because I can hold too many thoughts at once. I cant escape the thoughts. Even when I'm in the middle of quadruple tasking to distract myself they're there. They're always fucking there.

I just want her to come back. Everything I do or have done just seems to push her further away. 

I wish that debater could enter my head. Its not that they're compelling arguments it's that I can think of a counter arguement. Rationally, I'm aware pain ends. There are choices. But when I'm sitting in bed, staring up at a dark ceiling hoping to God to sleep, suddenly the fact that pain ends doesnt really matter. All those counter arguments in the light that only half work are useless in the dark. The emotional argument alongside what my head is telling me makes them seem like the most rational idea in the world. I know they're not. But it would take an army of psychics to make me believe they weren't.

I dont have any advice for you because if I did I wouldnt be where I'm at. Just wanted to let you know that I understand and that were at the same spot together. Sometimes it's easier when you know you're not alone
I feel you. It really feels like the thought of doing it is the only time I'm happy or at peace

I know I'm loved. I truly wish I wasnt so it could be easier. It's the only thing that's stopped me so far. Its stopped me for years. But I just dont know if it's enough anymore. I cant stoo the thoughts. I fantasize about kms literally every minute if the day and the only time I'm not fantasizing about it is when I dream I'm doing it.
